AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.WeakMeasurableEvolution.marginal_balance_of_locally_bounded_generator.{u_1,
    u_2}
  {Ω : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [TopologicalSpace S] [CompactSpace S] [SecondCountableTopology S]
  [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S] (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (X : NNReal → Ω → S)
  (hX : Measurable (Function.uncurry X)) (g : S → ℝ) (hg : Continuous g) (A : NNReal → S → ℝ)
  (hA : Measurable (Function.uncurry A)) (hBound : ∀ (T : NNReal), ∃ C, ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ (w : S), ‖A t w‖ ≤ C)
  (hbalance :
    ∀ (t : NNReal),
      ∃ Z,
        MeasureTheory.Integrable Z ↑P ∧
          ∫ (ω : Ω), Z ω ∂↑P = 0 ∧
            ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂↑P, g (X t ω) - g (X 0 ω) = (∫ (v : ℝ) in 0..↑t, A v.toNNReal (X v.toNNReal ω)) + Z ω) :
  have hSlice := ⋯;
  have ρ := fun t => P.map ⋯;
  have F := fun t => ∫ (w : S), g w ∂↑(ρ t.toNNReal);
  have B := fun t => ∫ (w : S), A t.toNNReal w ∂↑(ρ t.toNNReal);
  MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrable B MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    (∀ (a b : NNReal), F ↑b - F ↑a = ∫ (v : ℝ) in ↑a..↑b, B v) ∧
      (∀ (T : NNReal), AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval F 0 ↑T) ∧
        ∀ᵐ (t : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi 0), HasDerivAt F (B t) t

def AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.{u_1} : {X : Type u_1} → [PseudoMetricSpace X] → (ℝ → X) → ℝ → ℝ → Prop :=
fun {X} [PseudoMetricSpace X] f a b =>
  Filter.Tendsto (fun E => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range E.1, dist (f (E.2 i).1) (f (E.2 i).2))
    (AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.totalLengthFilter ⊓
      Filter.principal (AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.disjWithin a b))
    (nhds 0)
